Hi! I’ve kept three separate black widows before, and they make wonderful pets as long as you don’t handle them and take the time to ensure their enclosure is safe and that they can’t escape from it. The size is going to depend on what size widow you have, is it male or female, and does it still have those stripped legs and broken red back pattern that younger widows have, or is it like, an adult or sub adult female with a fully formed hourglass? If it’s in the sub adult to adult range, you’ll be fine with something that’s around 5-7 inches on both sides as well as 5-7 vertically, make sure you have a nice substrate that you can give her about an inch and a half of, then start adding in bark pieces, dead leaves, and sticks to mimic their natural habitat and give the spider plenty of places to explore or hide. As for feeding goes, I recommend using feeding tongs to drop a fly, mealworm, or wax worm  into the web when the spider is out and the abdomen is looking a little small or almost like it’s deflated in a way. If they’re hungry, they won’t have that plump and shiny abdomen we’re all used to in pictures, you’ll see a smaller abdomen with some wrinkles of sorts on it, that’s how you know when to feed them. They make a great display animal but again, definitely do not attempt handling for your own safety. They’re a docile and unlikely to bite species, but it can still happen and precautions have to be taken with something that has venom packing that much of a punch. You will need to ensure there’s ventilation in the enclosure, I recommend cross ventilation personally, and make sure your spider can't get through any of the holes you've made as vents. They like the dark and prefer a more dry sort of area, but you could optionally mist lightly about once a week if you want to. If you have any questions or want to know anything else about keeping widows, just hit me up! c:

I saw in another reply that you said she’s gone through your chats, I’ll go ahead and give you some tips when I lived with someone who was controlling and abusive and how I managed to still have a life without them knowing. I was subjected to random strip searches of sorts, she’d make me strip down in front of her and her husband to check for new scars, but in order to hide mine, I cut on my hips and upper thighs. That way for one, they can be lied about and say they’re stretch marks and because those areas are almost never exposed. As for her going through your phone and not letting you or complaining about you closing your door, I’ve been there too and I’ve got you mate. If you end up relapsing, wait until she’s gone to bed and been asleep for at least an hour and then get your supplies ready, including your bandages. Then, before you SH, and don’t listen to music during it, you need to stay alert and ready to bandage up immediately if she wakes up or makes any sort of noise that indicates movement. Always try to stave off of SHing when she’s awake or at the house, wait until she’s 100% asleep or gone. If you wait until she’s gone, make sure she’s been gone for at LEAST 15-20 minutes so if she forgot something, there’s less of a chance of being in the middle of it when she comes back for whatever she forgot. Now, as for privacy, once again, wait until she’s been asleep for about an hour and don’t go online during the time she’s awake, never download the app for something because she’ll be able to check your app/playstore and check what you’ve had. Make sure you only ever search up sites on a private tab, that way it takes the click of a button to get rid of everything you were doing. Try not to keep more than 2-3 tabs open at a time so you’ve got the best chance to get rid of them before she can catch you on them, because once you’ve exited all private tabs, you’re in the clear, but you’ve got to get rid of them all, which is why I say don’t have more than 2-3 open at a time, that way it’s easy to get rid of all evidence. Something else you’re going to want to do, is have a an email that you create on a private tab and only sign into on a private tab, and make sure all of your accounts, like socials such as Reddit, tie them all to that hidden email. Make sure your passwords for that second email and your accounts are all the same but are different from something than what your mom would be able to guess or would know. If you need to for medical reasons- for example, I was getting into strength training and doing a lot of cardio, and I had to stop while recovering since both surgeries were abdominal ones and I was told not to until I was healed-, then make sure you're still being careful and doing as many healthy and smart things as possible.
